- Expected concurrency: ~6 concurrent users during peak working hours

- Option A: Tue, Apr 13 — 10:00–11:00 PT (Redwood-led kickoff + tech deep dive with our SE)
- Option B: Wed, Apr 14 — 13:00–14:00 PT (alternate slot)

I attached a short draft trial charter (trial-charter.pdf) that lays out scope, timeline (2-week eval), and proposed success metrics. If either slot works, I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in Ben (solutions engineer) for the technical deep dive.

Would you prefer Option A (Apr 13 10–11 PT) or Option B? Also, let me know if you want to include anyone else from your team in the kickoff.

Thanks — look forward to getting this scheduled.
